C2 and C3 have the same cost and are also acceptable once the concession is confirmed.

C1, C2 and C3 each cost 404.28 USD with 3 min extra holding (120 kg), and F-1 passes at 2200 kg against the 1800 kg reserve, which is well below my 13 min fuel-safe limit. They are safe only once ATC_EARLIER_SLOT is confirmed (R-1 currently fails), and they are cheaper and less holding than C4 to C6 (1617.12 USD, 12 min), so I offer no concession.

C1 passes G-1, G-2, G-3 and C-1 on gate B4 with CRW-B4 on shift, with 0 overtime and 0 missed connections, and it has the lowest total cost at $404.28 with 120 kg holding fuel. C4 to C6 are safe outright at $1617.12 each, so I accept them as fallbacks, but C1 to C3 are only usable if ATC_EARLIER_SLOT is confirmed.
